summary: Short 17 m kerb at a junction corner, very steep and beside homes.

best_section.where: South kerb of Auburn Terrace at the corner of the side street

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block behind the kerb to the south and a house 11 m away; unsecluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, one car already parked on this kerb; barely one van length at a corner.
drivers.convention: Parked cars on the street, no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Mostly open; small trees along the verge and a tree to the north-west.
